name: Basic salary (基本工资)
authority: 劳动合同法 第十七条 (劳动报酬为劳动合同必备条款); 工资支付暂行规定 第七条 (工资至少每月支付一次). A part month is paid by calendar days. A sub-monthly entity pays each part its share (÷ `period.parts`); statutory stays month-to-date.

name: Overtime on working days (延长工作时间 150%)
authority: 劳动法 第四十四条第一项: 安排劳动者延长工作时间的, 支付不低于工资的150%的工资报酬; 工资支付暂行规定 第十三条. Approved overtime hours on working days (`work.days[]`, not a REST/OFF day, a substitute day off or a public holiday). 劳动和社会保障部《关于职工全年月平均工作时间和工资折算问题的通知》(劳社部发〔2008〕3号) 第二条: 日工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ 21.75; 小时工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ (21.75 × 8). SH from 2026-08-01: 上海市企业工资支付办法 (沪人社规〔2026〕10号) 第九条, the base is the post's normal monthly wage excluding bonuses and special allowances https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20260731/t0035_1442850.html.
eligibility: sum(work.days.filter(d, !((d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"] || d.holiday_kind == "SUBSTITUTE") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && d.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY").map(d, d.overtime_hours)) > 0.0
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, !((d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"] || d.holiday_kind == "SUBSTITUTE") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && d.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY").map(d, d.overtime_hours))

name: Statutory holiday work (法定休假日 300%)
authority: 劳动法 第四十四条第三项: 法定休假日安排劳动者工作的, 支付不低于工资的300%的工资报酬; 工资支付暂行规定 第十三条; 全国年节及纪念日放假办法. Hours worked on a published PUBLIC_HOLIDAY (clocked hours, else approved overtime hours); the bridging days off of a holiday arrangement are rest days (REST_DAY_WORK). 劳动和社会保障部《关于职工全年月平均工作时间和工资折算问题的通知》(劳社部发〔2008〕3号) 第二条: 日工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ 21.75; 小时工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ (21.75 × 8). SH from 2026-08-01: 上海市企业工资支付办法 (沪人社规〔2026〕10号) 第九条, the base is the post's normal monthly wage excluding bonuses and special allowances https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20260731/t0035_1442850.html.

name: Rest-day work (休息日 200%)
authority: 劳动法 第四十四条第二项: 休息日安排劳动者工作又不能安排补休的, 支付不低于工资的200%的工资报酬; 工资支付暂行规定 第十三条. Hours on a REST/OFF day of the planned shifts or a substitute day off (`work.days[]`). An entity that gives compensatory rest instead records `rest_day_work_compensated`; the make-up working weekends of a holiday arrangement are not distinguishable from rest days in the roster. 劳动和社会保障部《关于职工全年月平均工作时间和工资折算问题的通知》(劳社部发〔2008〕3号) 第二条: 日工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ 21.75; 小时工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ (21.75 × 8). SH from 2026-08-01: 上海市企业工资支付办法 (沪人社规〔2026〕10号) 第九条, the base is the post's normal monthly wage excluding bonuses and special allowances https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20260731/t0035_1442850.html.
eligibility: ((has(company.facts.rest_day_work_compensated) && company.facts.rest_day_work_compensated == true) ? 0.0 : sum(work.days.filter(d, (d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"] || d.holiday_kind == "SUBSTITUTE") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && d.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY").map(d, (d.worked_hours > 0.0 ? d.worked_hours : d.overtime_hours)))) > 0.0
quantity: (has(company.facts.rest_day_work_compensated) && company.facts.rest_day_work_compensated == true) ? 0.0 : sum(work.days.filter(d, (d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"] || d.holiday_kind == "SUBSTITUTE") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && d.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY").map(d, (d.worked_hours > 0.0 ? d.worked_hours : d.overtime_hours)))

name: Unpaid leave deduction (事假扣款)
authority: 工资支付暂行规定 第十一条至第十二条; 劳动和社会保障部《关于职工全年月平均工作时间和工资折算问题的通知》(劳社部发〔2008〕3号) 第二条: 日工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ 月计薪天数 (21.75天); 小时工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ (月计薪天数 × 8小时). Fund-paid maternity days and unpaid personal leave are deducted at the daily wage.

name: Untaken annual leave pay (未休年休假工资报酬)
authority: 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 第十条、第十一条: 300% of the daily wage, which includes the normal wage already paid for the day worked, so the further 200% is paid; daily wage = monthly wage ÷ 21.75.

name: Sick pay reduction (病假工资)
authority: The unpaid part of a sick day at the daily wage: SICK_LEAVE.pay_fraction (沪劳保发〔1995〕83号 scale, 80% minimum-wage floor). 劳动和社会保障部《关于职工全年月平均工作时间和工资折算问题的通知》(劳社部发〔2008〕3号) 第二条: 日工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ 21.75; 小时工资 = 月工资收入 ÷ (21.75 × 8). SH from 2026-08-01: 上海市企业工资支付办法 (沪人社规〔2026〕10号) 第九条, the base is the post's normal monthly wage excluding bonuses and special allowances https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20260731/t0035_1442850.html.
quantity: sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.code == "SICK_LEAVE" && r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && r.pay_fraction < 1.0).map(r, (1.0 - r.pay_fraction) * r.days))
